criteria.title: Validate the bounded ELF program-header contract before committing mappings.
criteria.task: Construct ELF64 byte fixtures that fail late: ninth PT_LOAD, filesz>memsz, wrapped offsets, entry outside executable bytes, overlapping pages and a writable executable segment. Validate all headers before mapping and snapshot frame state on refusal.
criteria.purpose: Validating each segment while immediately mapping can leave partial state after a later invalid segment.
